newsitem.title: USA: Metrika IPO modifies terms -- underwriter.
newsitem.headline: Metrika IPO modifies terms -- underwriter.

text.p: Terms were modified for the planned initial public offering in Metrika Systems Corp after the proposed number of shares were lowered and the estimated price range raised, lead underwriter Salomon Brothers said on Tuesday.

Metrika proposed to offer 2.0 million shares, down from its initial proposal of 3.0 million shares. The estimated price range, however, was increased to $15.50 to $18.50 from an original $7.50 to $9.50.
The offering is expected to trade on Thursday under the proposed symbol "MKA" on the American Stock Exchange.
Metrika develops, manufactures and markets on-line industrial process optimization systems.
